title: Decision Buffer Days on a Prescription Insurance on File Continuation Supply by Denial Reason
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, the reason the plan gave for the denial being appealed — the most recent denial on the coverage — adds a decision buffer to a continuation supply.

| Reason on the denial being appealed | Decision buffer added | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Step therapy required | 7 days | So that a step drug can be started if the denial is upheld |
| Missing information | 3 days | — |
| Any other reason | None | — |

## In words

When the denial being appealed gave step therapy required as its reason, 7 days are added so that a step drug can be started if the denial is upheld; when it gave missing information, 3 days are added; a denial for any other reason adds no decision buffer.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- The most recent denial on the coverage reads "step therapy required": 7 days added.
- It reads "missing information": 3 days added.
- It reads "not medically necessary": nothing added.
- An earlier denial read "step therapy required", but the most recent reads "not medically necessary": nothing added, because the denial read is the most recent one.
